newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures jump in active trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures jump in active trading.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures jumped in active late afternoon trading on Thursday as buyers emerged after Wednesday's slump, brokers said.
The prompt January contract last traded at $22.80 per barrel, up 26 cents from its last close on the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) at $22.54, with 517 lots recorded at 0958 GMT.
February last traded $22.30, up 30 cents against its last IPE close, with 240 lots traded at 0957 GMT.
Brokers said they see prompt month support at between $22.25 and $22.50.

Brokers said the recovery on the after-hours ACCESS trading system also helped boost the SIMEX Brent contract. ACCESS for the new prompt month of January last traded at $23.58, up 25 cents from its last NYMEX close, while February last traded at $23.27, also 25 cents over its previous close.
